name: io.github.FerhatDundar/aws-mcp-connector
description: MCP server for the AWS CLI. Read-only by default; single Go binary.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Named profile from ~/.aws/config to use. Leave unset to use the default profile.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Default AWS region if not set elsewhere.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Static AWS access key. Only needed if not using a profile/SSO/role.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Static AWS secret key. Only needed if not using a profile/SSO/role.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Temporary session token, if using short-lived credentials.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to permit mutating AWS CLI commands. Defaults to read-only.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_MCP_ALLOWED_SERVICES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of AWS CLI service names (e.g. "s3,ec2"). Unset allows all.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_MCP_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the aws binary. Defaults to "aws" resolved via PATH.
